text: In this tower defense game, you're not defending the kingdom.
Evilos. An ancient evil sorcerer, holding off endless waves of heroes with meteors, lightning and magic guns.
Your undead bodyguards include Scary Potter and Arnold Schwarzenecro.
Ten acts, each ending in a boss fight, and the store lists twelve languages.
The demo itself is under eight hundred megabytes.
Worth a dip. Being evil looks fun.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
